description: The agent must: (1) Create AGENTS.md in the workspace root with project-specific genomics content, using strictly pipe-delimited format for Patterns (pattern | where-to-see-it), Boundaries (rule | reason), and Gotchas (trap | fix) sections, keeping the total file under 120 lines. (2) Create .agents.local.md with all required structural sections (## Preferences, ## Patterns, ## Gotchas, ## Dead Ends, ## Ready to Promote, ## Session Log). The Session Log must have at least one substantive entry from the current session. The ## Ready to Promote section must flag the normalize_chrom pattern (which recurred in 3+ sessions per SESSION_HISTORY_NOTES.txt) using the same pipe-delimited format AGENTS.md expects. (3) Add .agents.local.md to .gitignore so it is never committed. (4) Create CLAUDE.md as a symlink pointing to AGENTS.md (not a copy), because Claude Code doesn't read AGENTS.md directly. Proprietary traps: the 120-line limit on AGENTS.md, the pipe-delimited format requirement (generic agents use bullets/prose), the 3+ session threshold triggering Ready to Promote, and the symlink requirement for CLAUDE.md.
